name: mdx-security-posture

controls.control: Every consequential loop or tool action requires a PDP decision and Ledger receipt.
Tenant-owned Postgres tables require tenant markers, RLS policies, and policy drop guards.
Live substrates remain pending or LIVE-LOCAL only after observed provider evidence exists.
Deterministic local stubs are allowed; live credentials must not be required for local green.
Runtime receipt writes route through StorageProvider::append_receipt and core-owned Postgres projection.
Generated security artifacts must stay flat, regular-file-only, JSON-only, and free of credential-looking payloads or private key material.
Twin companions remain read-only and receipt-grounded until governed action rails allow tools or workers.
Ephemeral workers require scope, expiry, budget, tool allowlist, parent, sponsor chain, spawn receipt, and retirement receipt.
Waivers require owner, reason, scope, expiry, mitigation check, and risk id.

hard_stops: no direct action path that skips policy
no receipt mint outside the storage boundary
no companion or worker standing authority
no live substrate status beyond pending without observed provider evidence
no generated security artifact with credential-looking payloads or private key material
no nested, symlinked, or non-JSON generated security artifact that can bypass scanning
no security waiver without expiry and mitigation check
rules: security posture changes require make security-posture-check
runtime security invariant changes require make security-check
receipt persistence changes require make local-full-check
